uk.s: Crazy Wednesday Black Week Special: Register to Draw, Unlock WLFI, Black & Gold Luxuries and High-Yi...
Token rewards for Event 1 will be distributed in WLFI tokens.

Black Week begins with an exclusive selection of timeless luxury gifts. Register for this event to receive a mystery box draw chance and unlock exciting rewards, including Rolex Submariner Date two-tone watch, medium Dior Toujours bag, and Van Cleef & Arpels Vintage Alhambra bracelet. Participate in Simple Earn to enjoy up to 100% APR on USDT, and earn up to 16% APR by staking BTC, ETH, or SOL. Multiple rewards are ready — start trading and earning now.

Token rewards for Event 1 will be distributed in WLFI tokens. Users who draw a lucky bag will share a total reward pool of 10,000 USDT, distributed in WLFI tokens, based on the proportion of lucky bags they receive. Physical rewards will be [airdropped] to users via the Gate Shop. Users must claim rewards within the validity period; unclaimed rewards will be deemed forfeited. Once an order is successfully placed in the Gate Shop, the product details and shipping information cannot be modified. Please ensure all information is accurate and complete before submitting your order. (Physical rewards cannot be returned or exchanged once shipped.) If a user provides incorrect or incomplete information, refuses delivery, returns the item, or cannot be contacted, the reward will be considered forfeited. Physical rewards will be delivered within 60 days after the submission of shipping details. Please monitor your logistics updates. If delivery cannot be completed due to force majeure or shipping issues, an equivalent amount in USDT will be issued instead. The event will automatically end once all rewards have been distributed. All rewards will be distributed to users' accounts within 14 working days after the event ends.

During the event, users who register will receive one mystery box draw chance. Complete the tasks below to earn additional mystery box opportunities. Rewards include WLFI, Rolex Submariner Date two-tone watch, a medium Dior Toujours bag, and a Van Cleef & Arpels Vintage Alhambra bracelet. Limited rewards are available on a first-come, first-served basis. The prize pool is updated daily at 00:00 (UTC). If the prize pool is fully claimed on the final day, the campaign will end automatically.
Simple Earn data was updated on November 25, 2026. The actual APR is subject to the subscription page.
Staking data was updated on November 25 2026. The actual APR is subject to the subscription page.
